messages:
support-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: spike in p99 latency for `text.generate` (us-east-1). Multiple customer escalations opened. Rolling window 10m, p99 ~2.3s (baseline 0.6s).

jess: seeing the support tickets, assigning triage. Which infra teams should we pull in? customer impact looks widespread but not total outage.

alex: tagging eng-runtime. any recent deploys to model-serving or routing in us-east?

maria: checking metrics now — ingress queue depth up ~3x, worker avail low, admission reject rate bumped. Prefix KV cache miss rate also increased (~12% -> 48%). No full deploy in last 30m on serving.

kevin: infra autoscaler showed some throttling on the dedicated pool because of an instance provisioning delay in the AZ. That caused admission to pileup.

jess: ok, customers need mitigation now. Can we (1) reduce per-tenant concurrency temporarily, (2) enable fallback model (smaller) for non-SLAs, and (3) scale up pool manually?

alex: agree. Plan: lower per-tenant concurrency from 16 -> 6 for non-prem tenants, route low-priority traffic to fallback-512 model, and add 4 extra instances to dedicated-worker-pool-us-east. I'll run quick cmds.

alex: running: ```
# lower tenant concurrency for public tier
redwoodctl routing update --pool ingress-us-east --concurrency-limit 6 --selector tier=public
# enable fallback model for low-priority
redwoodctl models promote --from model-xl --to model-512 --selector tier=public --traffic 80%
# scale pool
redwoodctl infra scale --pool dedicated-worker-pool-us-east --add 4
```

ops-bot: Command accepted: infra scale started (job id: jb-7721). ETA for new instances ~4m.

maria: after lowering concurrency the queue depth dropped within 30s, admission rejects reduced. Observed immediate p95 improvement from 0.9s -> 0.65s. p99 trending down but still elevated. KV cache miss still high; likely cache cold due to node churn.

jess: can we warm the cache for top prefixes used by heavy customers? any quick way to prefill?

alex: yes — kicking off a lightweight synthetic replay for top 50 prefixes: ```
redwoodctl replay --pool ingress-us-east --prefix-file /tmp/top50.prefixes --rate 50/s
``` should fill KV and warm kernel caches without overloading.

kevin: autoscaler finished adding instances early. ops-bot shows worker ready signals.

ops-bot: jb-7721 completed, 4 instances added, pool healthy.

maria: KV cache miss dropping (48% -> 18%) after replay, p99 now ~1.0s and falling. We'll keep monitoring for 20m.

jess: noted. I updated all open tickets with mitigation steps and ETA. Keeping customers informed.

alex: follow-up items: (a) investigate AZ provisioning delay root cause, (b) add quicker fallback policy when autoscaling stalls, (c) audit concurrency default for public tier. File follow-ups in eng-runtime backlog.

maria: also: update admission control to prefer shedding low-priority traffic earlier (protect premium routes). I'll open a PR for configurable priority weights.

jess: great. For now I'll keep thread open until p99 stable <0.9s for 30m. Please ping when we close. :thumbsup:

maria: 25m in, p99 steady ~0.78s, no new escalations. Cache hot set looks stable.

jess: closing escalation — customers updated, runbook steps documented. Thanks all for quick response.

alex: noted postmortem items and will add timeline to eng-releases.

support-bot: Incident closed by jess at 3067890450.
